# Which of your Whatnot shows and categories actually make money?

> Free analyzer for Whatnot sellers: load your orders CSV and see profit per sale, show and category after Whatnot commission and payment processing, with effective fee rate, cost basis by SKU, low-price sale drag and the shows and categories that lose money. Reads Whatnot's Seller Weekly Orders Report by the column names in Whatnot's help article (refunds and shipping charges taken off their sale, giveaways kept, fee taxes counted). Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
